Name: 7yrsofbadluck's Witch Hats - Json Assets
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: A set of witch hats in seven varieties
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT HERE, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

Thanks to JsonAssets, have some cute witch hats without replacing any of your vanilla hats!  All hats can be purchased through the Hat Mouse, or spawned in with [CJB Item Spawner](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93/)﻿.

This mod requires [Json Assets](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720) to work.

WORKS WITH SDV 1.4!

Install

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io/)﻿﻿.

2.  Install the latest version of [Json Assets](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720)﻿.

3.  Download this mod and unzip it, then copy the '[JA] Witch Hats' folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.

4.  Play the game, you're done!
Version changes

*   1.2.0 - Added Spanish translation, thanks to [Ailer](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/41611600)﻿!

*   1.1.0 - Added the four new varieties (finally!)

*   1.0.2 - Bug fixes for folder names

*   1.0.1 - Initial version
Credit for the original [mod](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/612)﻿ goes to [7yrsofbadluck](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4632040)﻿, who kindly gave permission for this conversion.

Source code found [here](https://github.com/minervamaga?tab=repositories)﻿.  Feel free to [submit a pull request](https://help.github.com/en/articles/creating-a-pull-request)﻿ with improvements or translations.  You can also [report issues or request features using the Issues tab](https://help.github.com/en/articles/creating-an-issue)﻿!
